summary: A DNR live-in cab on Lorena Butte, moved in 2006 to private Lefever Holbrook Ranch land and rented nightly; the original site is listed as gone, and sources disagree on the move year.

facts.design: 14x14 DNR-style live-in cab (ground house), built 1974 on a 10-foot concrete slab at the summit; the slab stayed behind at the 2006 move
facts.status_note: Standing at the relocated site on private land; the original site is listed as gone

access.note: On private land owned by the Lefever Holbrook Ranch. Nightly rentals are offered through the owners.

visit.trail_note: Booked rental guests only, through the owners. The dirt road to the top has one steep section.

facts.agency: Washington Department of Natural Resources (original administrator); the relocated cab is on private land

events.note: First known structure on Lorena Butte, an L-4 cab

Moved from the summit down a ridge to the southwest because of local mining operations. NHLR's photo caption says 2005 and Forest Lookouts says 2007.

corrections.proposed: 1937 first known structure (L-4 cab); 1954 DNR cab; 1974 current live-in cab
corrections.why: The site has held lookout structures since 1937. The 1974 date belongs only to the current cab.

corrections.current: None relocated (Moved from Lorena Butte to Lefever.)
corrections.proposed: Relocated 2006 from the summit down a ridge to the southwest (other sources say 2005 and 2007)
corrections.why: The record says the cab was moved but gives no relocation year. NHLR's text and TrailChick both give 2006.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR's text and TrailChick date the move to 2006. The NHLR photo caption says 2005 and the Forest Lookouts history says 2007. The story uses 2006 and reports the other two.
NHLR dates the DNR cab to 1954. A Goldendale Sentinel quote, reproduced by Forest Lookouts, says the lookout was erected in 1953. The story uses 1954 and says the newspaper gave 1953.
Firelookout.org lists the original site as Gone and the relocated cab as Standing. The brief's standing status applies to the relocated cab.

notes_for_editor: Build years (1937, 1954, 1974) and the 2022 registration are well supported. The relocation year is disputed (2005 NHLR caption, 2006 NHLR text and TrailChick, 2007 Forest Lookouts); the story uses 2006. The brief's 'None relocated' entry is wrong and is corrected. The TrailChick rental price ($150 a night, 2021) is left out as probably stale. A Lefever Holbrook Ranch farm-stay page and a WillhiteWeb history page appeared in search results but were not read, so nothing from them is used. The site is private land: visitor access is only by booking through the owners, and no public access is implied.
